build_masked_lm_model: build a MaskedLMModel instance using MaskedLMModel.build_model with args and task
run_masked_lm_encoder_forward: run the MaskedLMEncoder forward pass with src_tokens and segment_labels to get logits
configure_bert_base_architecture: configure a BERT base architecture with 12 layers, 768 embed dim, and 12 attention heads
configure_bert_large_architecture: configure a BERT large architecture with 24 layers, 1024 embed dim, and 16 attention heads
configure_xlm_base_architecture: configure an XLM base architecture with 6 layers, 1024 embed dim, and gelu activation
